Record Class TransactionPreImage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.repository.helper.TransactionPreImage
Record Components:
idCashaccount - the cash account the transaction was booked on
transactionDate - the date part of the former transaction time, matching the tt_date column the hold tables are grouped by
idSecurityaccount - the security account, or null for a cash-only transaction
idSecuritycurrency - the security, or null for a cash-only transaction
public record TransactionPreImage(Integer idCashaccount, LocalDate transactionDate, Integer idSecurityaccount, Integer idSecuritycurrency) extends Record
Immutable snapshot of the coordinates a Transaction occupied before it was updated. The hold tables are keyed by cash account plus date and by security account plus security, so an update that moves a transaction to another account or to a later date invalidates hold rows that the new coordinates alone can never reach.

It has to be a copy rather than a reference to the existing entity: the "existing entity" handed to saveOnlyAttributes is the managed instance that merge writes the new values into, so by the time the transaction has been saved it no longer holds the old values. Capture the snapshot before the save.

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static TransactionPreImage of(Transaction existingEntity)
      Captures the coordinates of an existing transaction, or returns null when there is nothing to capture (creation rather than update). Call this before the transaction is saved.

      A transaction without an id is treated as absent: on the create path of a cash account transfer, UpdateCreate.checkAndSetEntityWithTenant hands back the very instance being created as the "existing" entity, so identity alone does not tell a create from an update.

      Parameters:
      existingEntity - the transaction as it is currently stored, may be null for a new transaction
      Returns:
      the snapshot, or null when there is no stored predecessor

    • earliestAffectedDate

      public LocalDate earliestAffectedDate(LocalDate transactionDateNow)
      The earliest date that has to be recalculated when a transaction moves between dates. Hold rows are cumulative running totals, so moving a transaction forward in time leaves every row between the old and the new date carrying the old amount; recalculation therefore has to start at the earlier of the two.
      Parameters:
      transactionDateNow - the date the transaction carries after the update
      Returns:
      the earlier of the former and the current date
